title: Creating a session in a remote project with an explicit workdir fails because the workdir is resolved on the local host
outcome: Creating a session in a remote project with an explicit workdir fails because the workdir is resolved on the local host
acceptance: POST /api/sessions for a project whose remote_id is not the local remote forwards a requested workdir to the remote without resolving or validating it as a local path, and the remote validates it on its own host
A regression test covers creating a remote-project session with an explicit remote-only workdir (a path that does not exist on the local host) and shows it is accepted and passed through
Local-project session creation keeps its existing local workdir validation unchanged
